## Deferrals read (docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md)

- `DF-S1.3-2` — "participant origin mints unverified; the ≤ delegate mint
  for Hosting-ABI-vouched participant claims is not yet reachable".
  **This ticket closes it**: `lab.hosting.attach` validates the
  participant's registry record, then mints participant-origin rows under
  a `MintingContext.vouched_participants` containing the checked
  `version_identity` → `delegate`. Unvouched participant content still
  mints `unverified`; `is_delegate_class` still bars endorsement.
- Everything else in blast radius stays OPEN with dated progress notes.

## Design rulings (recorded before code; ADRs follow)

- **D1 — records-in/records-out preserves `hosting_edges = []`.** No
  workspace crate gains a normal dep on `hh-hosting`. The boundary's
  `lab.hosting.{describe,probe,attach}` ops are: a registry read
  (describe), a conformance-entry append + quarantine with an optional
  injected *hosting plane* driver (probe), and a hosted-session
  binding/record write through a caller-supplied writer lease (attach).
- **D2 — `HostingPlane` is a Json seam.** `EmbedService::set_hosting_plane`
  takes `Box<dyn FnMut(&str, &Json) -> Result<Json, String>>` — pure
  records-in/out, contract-only (CC5). `probe{drive: true}` and any
  future participant-facing drive forward to it; absent →
  `Refused{hosting_plane_absent}` — honest tier absence, never faked.
  Tests wire `hh_hosting::Service` in-process (dev-dep only).
- **D3 — `lab.hosting.attach` is the hosted-session write.** Params
  `{run_id, lease{lease_id,holder,generation,expires_at_ms}, participant_ref,
  adapter_ref?, session{session_ref, participant_version_identity,
  mechanism, placement, observability_level, abi_version, mediation,
  budget_enforcement?, capability_vector?, conformance?}, rows[]?,
  events[]?, end_state?, drift_entries[]?}`. First attach mints
  `lifecycle.hosted.attached` + `lifecycle.component.bound{class_id:
  hosting_adapter}`; `rows[]` mint as ledger events under a bounded class
  allowlist (never `action.effect.*`/`security.host_effect` —
  participant-reported tool events stay `action.tool.*`/observed);
  `events[]` land as one `lifecycle.hosted.native_record` leaf;
  `end_state` → `lifecycle.hosted.detached`; drift entries →
  `lifecycle.hosted.drift_observed`; then the hh-eval hosted fold mints
  `measurement.metric.emitted` rows for the seven hosted metrics.
- **D4 — engine emits the attach pair at launch.** `HostedLaunchOutcome`
  gains additive `observability_level`, `mediation`,
  `capability_vector`, `budget_enforcement`,
  `participant_version_identity`, `abi_version`; `run_hosted_arm` stamps
  `manifest.observability_level` + `manifest.extra` strata and appends
  `lifecycle.hosted.attached`/`component.bound{hosting_adapter}` on the
  subject ledger (`lab.hosting.attach` skips `attached` when the session
  already has one — both paths converge on one row).
- **D5 — reconcile lives in hh-registry.** `reconcile_capability_vector(
  declaration, entries, current_version_identity)` — the one rule
  (CC1): latest non-stale concrete record per dimension, else the
  declaration value, else `unknown`; stale entries annotate, never hide.
- **D6 — probe op is dual-mode.** `entry` supplied → records-in append;
  `drive: true` → forward to the plane then append. `skipped` when the
  environment cannot exercise the probe — never `unsupported`.
- **D7 — `participant` noun is additive + removable.** hh-cli gains
  `tier-c2` (default-on) gating the `participant` dispatch arms;
  `hh participant describe|probe|register|conformance` map to
  `lab.hosting.describe`, `lab.hosting.probe`, `lab.registry.register`,
  `lab.registry.record_conformance` — one boundary op per verb (N-3).
- **D8 — conformance durability.** `lab.hosting.probe` marks the named
  `run_id` durable (kernel registrar); when omitted the boundary's own
  registry run stands in (the instrument's own ledger run — the
  `charged_to = instrument` floor), `evidence_ref` carries the probe's
  actual detail ref.

## Requirement matrix

| Item | Requirement | Implementation plan |
|---|---|---|
| hh-hosting/1 handshake | describe → abi_versions[]; attach highest mutual major; none advertised → v1 + every declaration unknown; unknown major → AbiVersionUnsupported; unknown minor attaches w/ unknown fields preserved | `hh_hosting::abi::{AbiVersion, negotiate}`; `HostingExt.abi_versions`; `extra` member preservation (existing) |
| Baseline verbs | describe, open, submit, cancel, resume (mode declared), close, stream_events, probe (Lab-side), upcalls request_permission/report_usage | `hh_hosting::service::HostingService` driving an `Adapter`/`SessionTransport` |
| Capability-declared verbs | set_coordinate (per coordinate), steer, account (exact), export (trajectory), elicit | `service.rs` capability gates over the resolved `capability_vector` |
| Excluded verbs | the §6.6 §2.1 closed list → refused, no raw pass-through | `abi::EXCLUDED_VERBS`; `Service::handle` returns `ExcludedVerb` |
| HostedEvent + lifting | envelope + per-mechanism lift tables + loss classes + dense seq + synthesized unobserved terminals + authority ceiling | existing `events.rs`/`proj.rs`; service assigns seq/stamps at ingest; `lift` gains the `usage.reported` origin→provenance mapping |
| Mediation stamps | mediated/observed/unobserved on every row; adapter never asserts `mediated` | `events::envelope_stamps` + attach-time `mediation` member |
| Boundary rule | policy/authority/credential values/budgets never delivered; `budget_view` advisory ContextItem only when `instruction_delivery` SUPPORTED | `HostedRunSpec` carries `connection_info` only; service drops `budget_view` unless declared |
| Placement | `process_placement`; connection_info never a handle | `HostedRunSpec.environment: Json` + `refuse_handle_keys`-style check in service |
| budget_enforcement | derived map, floor dims enforced, per mechanism×placement×intercept×env | `hh_hosting::budget::derive_budget_enforcement` + `check_ceiling` at submit/permission/model-call/EP3/wall-clock |
| Adapter A | session-ABI adapter; ACP-shaped method mapping; lifting table; auto-approval admission check; optional interception | `hh_hosting::adapter_a::{AdapterA, SessionTransport}` |
| Fixture participant | scripted session-ABI peer for tests + probes | `hh_hosting::fixture::FixtureParticipant` |
| Probe catalogue | P-01…P-16 with applies_to_mechanisms; P0 = {P-01,P-03,P-04,P-06,P-09,P-16} | `hh_hosting::probes::{PROBE_CATALOGUE, run_probe}` |
| Quarantine | DRIFT on P0 → admission quarantined; elsewhere → stratum annotation | `RegistryStore::quarantine` + `lifecycle.registry.quarantined` class + probe op |
| Conformance entries | per-dimension ConformanceRecord, stale on version_identity change, runtime contradictions `observed_in: run` | `lab.hosting.probe` records; `attach{drift_entries}` annotates runs |
| Hosted metric folds | the seven hosted declarations get real folds | `hh_eval::hosted::fold_hosted_metrics` over `(seq,class,payload)` rows + session record |
| AC-1 | native+hosted arm runs to completion; strata; class-aware n/a; InadmissibleFactor component-level | hh-embed integration test through `lab.experiment.*` + `lab.hosting.attach` + scorecard |
| AC-3 | empty declaration → unknown vector, product-level only; probes only change probed dims; unexercisable → skipped; P-06 drift quarantines | describe/probe integration tests |
| AC-4 | deny/ask Π rows; auto-approve adapter fails admission | service tests with injected decider; `AdapterA.auto_approve` check |
| AC-6 | matched_cap on non-enforced dimension → IncommensurableMatch; intercept upgrades | existing engine gate + hosted enforcement in Bag (test) |
| AC-7 | credential_supply channels only; canary refused at EP3; secret_leak computed under mediated(egress), n/a{mediation} without | service credential-channel check + egress rows + scorecard mediation gate |
| AC-8 | every AdapterRecord carries complete debt; link refuses without | `AdapterRecord` debt gate at attach + `debt_complete` check |
| AC-9 | intercept+report → two cost rows, distinct provenance, agreement; no report → NoPrice/unknown | `lift` provenance mapping + `usage_report_agreement` fold |
| AC-10 | unknown major refused; unknown minor attaches preserving ext; version change → vector stale | abi tests + describe staleness |
| R-2.10.1² | hosted desugaring populated, driver binding, T-4 diffs | verify existing desugar fields + `lab.assembly.diff` hosted test |
| R-2.10.3² | hosted levels through the verbs | launch/attach/settle path (AC-1) |
| R-2.11.1² | participant noun | hh-cli verbs + tier-c2 |
| N2 | the ABI is thin/observational | no native contract changes; allowlist of row families; `hosted_rows` carry observation only |
